_comment: ECS Fargate task definition for the web tier (SCALABILITY.md Step 1). Placeholders in @@...@@ are filled by IaC (terraform-aws-pilgrim). Secrets are referenced, never inlined. The container port matches the ALB target group (modules/ec2/alb.tf: port 8080); the target group health path becomes /api/health at cutover (SCALABILITY.md §6). ARM64 is the operator's choice (Graviton; native build on the M5). Until the web tier exists (Step 5) the image runs today's single-host server, so this is a shape to build IaC against, not a deployable service. STRIPE_SECRET_ARN is a Secrets Manager JSON {STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET} the app reads itself with the task role (pilgrim/aws_secrets.py); the task role needs GetSecretValue on it and on DB_PASS_SECRET_ARN.

command: import sys, urllib.request; r = urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/health', timeout=3); sys.exit(0 if r.status == 200 else 1)
